name: elevation-mcp-server
description: Terrain analysis over elevation data: route ascent/descent profiles, bounding-box elevation grids, line-of-sight clearance, and US 3DEP point elevation.

interface.shortDescription: Route ascent/descent profiles, elevation grids, and line-of-sight clearance.
interface.longDescription: Computes over terrain rather than just looking up height. Sample a route for total ascent, descent, and steepest grade, pull a bounding-box elevation grid with its highest and lowest cells, or check whether terrain blocks the line of sight between two points. Point elevation uses USGS 3DEP LiDAR-derived data where the US is covered and falls back to global SRTM data elsewhere, and every sample reports which dataset answered.
